# Cirrus

> A landing page template for open source projects, built to be driven by a coding agent. Plain React and CSS (Vite, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4), MIT licensed, static output, no trackers.

Start with AGENTS.md. It lists the commands, where everything lives, the ordered steps to turn the template into a landing page for a new project, and the rules the code has to keep following.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomirzakhanian/cirrus/main/AGENTS.md): commands, file map, customisation steps, rules
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomirzakhanian/cirrus/main/README.md): overview, deploy, page weight, credits

## Files you will edit first

- [src/site.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomirzakhanian/cirrus/main/src/site.ts): name, repo URL, license, every menu and footer link
- [src/App.tsx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomirzakhanian/cirrus/main/src/App.tsx): the page, one line per section
- [src/index.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomirzakhanian/cirrus/main/src/index.css): design tokens and font faces

## Use it

- [Repository](https://github.com/theomirzakhanian/cirrus)
- [Use this template](https://github.com/theomirzakhanian/cirrus/generate)
- [Live demo](https://cirrus-beige.vercel.app)
